answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose iCOPERNICUS, an In-Context Personalization Learning Scrutiny of Summarization capability in LLMs.

answer_2.quote: We use EGISES-JSD, the only known measure for personalized summarization.

answer_4.quote: We further validated PX-5 (the most serious paradox) using survey-based unbiased judgments (i.e., similarity ratings (1 (low) -6 (very high)) on summary-pairs, both reference and model-generated from 339 respondents.
answer_4.guideline: Respondents rated the similarity between pairs of summaries (both reference and model-generated) on a scale from 1 (low) to 6 (very high).
